We had an amazing aurora show last night for about an hour before the incoming storm clouds moved in. The temperature was pretty mild at 20 degrees, but the 18 mph NE winds coming across Lake Superior at my face made it feel a bit colder! 🥶 But it was all worth it.

Lake Michigan Ice “What good is the warmth of summer, without the cold of winter to give it sweetness.” --John Steinbeck, Travels with Charley: In Search of America I captured this close-up of the frozen waters of Lake Michigan right in front of the Milwaukee Art Museum's Quadracci Pavilion. I love how the cracks in the ice create such an abstract pattern, and the colors of the rocks beneath the water make a beautiful gradient from blue to green to orange. It was cold, but totally worth the walk to get this shot!
